subject: Refreshing the data R Shiny App that has been deployed

messages.author: eb40e3b9ab515c42
messages.subject: Refreshing the data R Shiny App that has been deployed
parts:
I can't seem to find a clear answer for this on the web, so here goes. Is it possible to update the data that a deployed R shiny app is based on? 
For example, the app has been deployed to the shiny app server, and the data that it uses has some rows added. 
Is there a way to 'refresh' the app so that it shows the latest data without having to redeploy the app?

parts:
Some test code I wrote a while back used the fileInput code to update a file reactive-ly and it did update the data instantly without redeploying. I didn't test with a database, but I imagine it would be similar / would need to reload the specific view.

I sadly don't have an example at this time.

messages.subject: Re: Refreshing the data R Shiny App that has been deployed
parts: If the file is on disk, try reactiveFileReader. If it's in a database, try reactivePoll. These are assuming you control the server and get the data up there. If you're talking about hosting on ShinyApps.io, then you can't do the reactiveFileReader approach; there's no way to update a ShinyApps.io app without redeploying it.
